newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chrysler launches new Cherokee in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler launches new Cherokee in Japan.

text.p: Chrysler Japan Sales Ltd, the Japanese unit of Chrysler Corp, on Wednesday launched a remodelled Chrysler Jeep Cherokee series in Japan.

The Japanese selling price will be 2.865 million yen for the Cherokee Sport, up from 2.778 million yen for the predecessor model, and 3.245 million yen for the Cherokee Limited, up from 3.098 million yen.
The price increase for the new Cherokees was based on improvements and additional safety devices, not because of a weak yen, a CJS spokeswoman said.
Cherokee models are sold through CJS's 120 sales outlets and 1,868 Honda's showrooms in Japan. Honda sells more than 80 percent of the total Japanese sales of Chrysler Cherokees.
CJS has not disclosed its sales target for the Cherokee models.
